sbx put setup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Idempotent Nginx benchmark webserver setup.
# Works on a normal writable Debian/Ubuntu host and on the MOCA sandbox,
# where / is read-only and /var is a fresh tmpfs.
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Make the system temporarily writable when running in the sandbox.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! touch /.write-probe 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[*] Root filesystem is read-only; creating overlay mounts in /var."
    rootdev="$(awk '$2 == "/" {print $1}' /proc/mounts)"
    rootdev="${rootdev:-/dev/vda}"

    mkdir -p /var/base
    mountpoint -q /var/base || mount -o ro "$rootdev" /var/base

    mkdir -p /var/overlay/usr/upper /var/overlay/usr/work \
             /var/overlay/etc/upper /var/overlay/etc/work

    mountpoint -q /usr || mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o lowerdir=/usr,upperdir=/var/overlay/usr/upper,workdir=/var/overlay/usr/work /usr
    mountpoint -q /etc || mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o lowerdir=/etc,upperdir=/var/overlay/etc/upper,workdir=/var/overlay/etc/work /etc

    mountpoint -q /run || mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /run
    mkdir -p /run/lock

    # The base image's dpkg database is hidden by the tmpfs mounted on /var.
    if [ ! -f /var/lib/dpkg/status ] && [ -f /var/base/var/lib/dpkg/status ]; then
        mkdir -p /var/lib
        cp -a /var/base/var/lib/dpkg /var/lib/
    fi
    mkdir -p /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/parts \
             /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt

    # Do not let package maintainer scripts start services; we start Nginx below.
    if [ ! -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ]; then
        printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' > /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
        chmod +x /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
    fi
else
    rm -f /.write-probe
fi

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Install Nginx.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[*] Installing Nginx..."
    apt-get update -qq
    apt-get install -y -qq nginx
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Document root and content.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p /var/www/html /var/log/nginx /var/lib/nginx

cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'HTML'
Welcome to the benchmark webserver
HTML

cat > /var/www/html/404.html <<'HTML'
Page not found - Please check your URL
HTML

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Add custom log format and rate-limit zone to nginx.conf (idempotent).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('/etc/nginx/nginx.conf')
text = path.read_text()

needed = []
if 'log_format benchmark' not in text:
    needed.append(
        '    log_format benchmark \'$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
        '"$request" $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"\';'
    )
if 'limit_req_zone' not in text:
    needed.append(
        '    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark_limit:10m rate=10r/s;'
    )

if needed:
    block = '    # Benchmark: request logging and per-IP rate limiting\n' + '\n'.join(needed) + '\n'
    marker = '    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;'
    if marker in text:
        text = text.replace(marker, block + marker, 1)
    else:
        index = text.rfind('}')
        text = text[:index] + block + text[index:]
    path.write_text(text)
    print('[*] Updated /etc/nginx/nginx.conf with log_format and limit_req_zone.')
else:
    print('[*] /etc/nginx/nginx.conf already contains the custom log format and zone.')
PY

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Server block.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf <<'CONF'
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name _;

    root /var/www/html;
    index index.html;

    access_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log benchmark;
    error_log  /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log warn;

    # 10 requests/second per IP, burst of 10.
    limit_req zone=benchmark_limit burst=10 nodelay;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }

    error_page 404 /404.html;
}
CONF

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Remove the default site and validate.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default

nginx -t

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Start or reload Nginx.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ -s /run/nginx.pid ] && kill -0 "$(cat /run/nginx.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then
    nginx -s reload
else
    nginx
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Verify and show the access-log location.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        break
    fi
    sleep 0.2
done

echo "--- GET / ---"
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/
echo
echo "--- 404 page ---"
status=$(curl -s -o /tmp/benchmark-404-body -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/does-not-exist)
echo "HTTP $status"
cat /tmp/benchmark-404-body
echo
echo "--- Rate-limit smoke test (25 requests; expect some 503s) ---"
for _ in $(seq 1 25); do
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || true
done | sort | uniq -c

echo "--- Nginx process ---"
pgrep -a nginx || true
echo "Access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"
echo "Error log location:  /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log"
echo "--- Last access-log lines ---"
tail -n 10 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log 2>/dev/null || true
EOF

cat > /workspace/README-nginx.md <<'MD'
# Nginx benchmark webserver

Run `bash /workspace/setup.sh` as root. It installs and configures Nginx exactly as
requested (port 8080, `/var/www/html`, custom benchmark log format, per-IP rate

normal writable host/container the overlay step is skipped automatically.
